habitats.name: ISS cabin
habitats.o2_quote: The ISS aims to operate at the 21% O2, 101.4 kPa (14.7 psia) point of the curve. Nonetheless, it has obtained much of its data at 24.1% O2, 101.4 kPa (14.7 psia) conditions due to sinusoidal fluctuations of oxygen with a mean of 21% O2
habitats.p_quote: the total pressure is maintained between 724 – 770.5 mmHg (14.0 – 14.9 psia)
habitats.gravity_quote: Results from low-gravity combustion experiments, conducted for example on the International Space Station (ISS)

habitats.name: Moon base
habitats.o2_quote: The intermediate oxygen concentration used on the Moon will likely be 30% or greater, with a corresponding pressure of 10.2 psi or less.
habitats.o2_note: '30% or greater': no upper bound given, so the window runs to 100%.
habitats.p_quote: The intermediate oxygen concentration used on the Moon will likely be 30% or greater, with a corresponding pressure of 10.2 psi or less.
